calls.statement:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT period_start_date AS d0, period_end_date AS d1 FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 2
),
sales AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN p ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.d0 AND p.d1
  WHERE s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY 1
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN p ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.d0 AND p.d1
  WHERE s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY 1
),
latest AS (
  SELECT store_id, store_name FROM dim_store WHERE is_current
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period,
       rank() OVER (ORDER BY sales.sales_net - coalesce(refunds.refund_net, 0) DESC) AS rank,
       sales.store_id, latest.store_name,
       round(sales.sales_net - coalesce(refunds.refund_net, 0), 2) AS net_sales_eur
FROM sales
LEFT JOIN refunds USING (store_id)
JOIN latest USING (store_id)
ORDER BY rank
